Title: Unauthenticated Supabase debug API mounted in AppModule
Description: Controller debug/supabase exposes listTables getTableRows fetchAllTablesData overview discover etc. with NO AuthGuard. Anyone who can reach the API can dump Supabase table samples and metadata. Registered in app.module.ts controllers array.
Recommendation: Gate entire controller behind NODE_ENV!==production AND admin auth OR remove from production builds; use env flag DEBUG_SUPABASE=false default.

Title: Hardcoded integration API key in source
Description: Literal string compared to query apiKey (same at line 129). Key is in repo history and binaries — anyone with repo read can call protected pagination/filtered endpoints.
Recommendation: Move to env e.g. VISITOR_SESSION_EXPORT_API_KEY; rotate compromised key; use timing-safe compare (crypto.timingSafeEqual on buffers).

Title: GET visitor-session/pagination/:workspaceId without JWT
Description: Lists paginated sessions for arbitrary workspaceId path param — no AuthGuard no apiKey on this route. Competitor or scraper can enumerate customer chat metadata if UUIDs leak.
Recommendation: Require AuthGuard; verify req.user belongs to workspaceId; or require same env-based API key as filtered routes.

Title: GET visitor-session/workspace/:workspaceId unauthenticated
Description: Returns sessions for any workspaceId without bearer token.
Recommendation: AuthGuard + workspace membership check.

Title: GET visitor-session/:id unauthenticated
Description: findOne exposes visitor session (optional fullChats) by UUID only — guess/leak of id yields PII and transcripts.
Recommendation: Require auth or signed widget token bound to session id; rate-limit.

Title: PUT visitor-session/:id and DELETE :id unauthenticated
Description: Update and delete visitor sessions with no AuthGuard — session tampering or denial.
Recommendation: AuthGuard + ownership checks.

Title: Entire chat-logs controller has no AuthGuard
Description: POST create GET list (optional workspaceId) GET :id PUT DELETE — all unauthenticated. Full chat log CRUD and enumeration by id/workspaceId.
Recommendation: Add class-level @UseGuards(AuthGuard); enforce workspace scope from JWT on every query.

Title: Entire analytics controller unauthenticated
Description: All routes under /analytics/:workspaceId/... return overview messages contacts heatmap events dashboard unread — no AuthGuard. UUID knowledge = full WA analytics exfiltration.
Recommendation: Add AuthGuard; verify user can access workspaceId and clientId.

Title: Canned responses CRUD without AuthGuard
Description: Routes under workspace/:workspaceId/canned-responses — only path segment identifies tenant. Unauthenticated create/list/update/delete of canned content and categories.
Recommendation: AuthGuard + workspace role checks on every handler.

Title: Visitor create/update endpoints unauthenticated
Description: POST /visitor and PUT /visitor — no guard. May be intentional for widget but enables spam bot registration and DB growth without CAPTCHA/rate limit visible here.
Recommendation: If public by design: strict rate limit IP fingerprint CAPTCHA; else AuthGuard for dashboard-only updates.

Title: Public GET workspace/public/:id returns full workspace via findOne
Description: No authentication. Combined with service spreading full Prisma row.
Recommendation: Remove or protect; return minimal DTO.

Title: findOne spreads full workspace including apiToken
Description: Prisma findUnique include users then ...workspace into JSON — leaks apiToken emails settings.
Recommendation: Select explicit safe columns; never spread ORM entity to HTTP.

Title: POST /whatsapp/send-message no AuthGuard
Description: Anonymous WhatsApp send attempts.
Recommendation: AuthGuard or bridge secret + workspace scope.

Title: POST /whatsapp/reestablish-connections unauthenticated
Description: Operational abuse DoS.
Recommendation: AuthGuard + admin.

Title: POST /whatsapp/clear-session unauthenticated
Description: Wipes session requiring QR re-pair.
Recommendation: AuthGuard strict role.

Title: GET /whatsapp/messages SSE CORS * no AuthGuard
Description: Unauthenticated stream; may expose QR and live events per service wiring.
Recommendation: Tokenized SSE URL or cookie session; narrow CORS.

Title: send-response without secret allowed when not production
Description: Non-production allows missing WHATSAPP_SEND_RESPONSE_SECRET path.
Recommendation: Always require secret in deployed environments.

Title: whatsapp/public controller intentionally unauthenticated
Description: send-message bulk etc. depend on brandId/clientId knowledge — integration abuse if ids leak.
Recommendation: HMAC per workspace rate limits IP allowlist.

Title: POST /whatsapp/send-location unauthenticated
Description: Location messages without JWT.
Recommendation: AuthGuard.

Title: POST /whatsapp/send-reply unauthenticated
Description: Reply path without guard before guarded block at 243.
Recommendation: AuthGuard.

Title: Widget embed URL includes apiToken query param
Description: Referrer logs browser history leakage.
Recommendation: Short-lived signed token for embed.

Title: GET /widget/ai-available returns available:true when key missing
Description: Line 47-48: missing key still returns available true with error field — callers may ignore error and treat as AI online.
Recommendation: Return available:false when key missing; HTTP 400.

Title: @Public POST workspace/designcater-bot
Description: Unauthenticated workspace+bot creation with file uploads — spam fake tenants storage cost.
Recommendation: Captcha invite-only token or remove Public in production.

Title: @Public POST workspace/create
Description: Same pattern — public onboarding endpoint abuse vector.
Recommendation: Rate limit email domain verification CAPTCHA.

Title: @Public GET :agentId/unanswered
Description: Unauthenticated unanswered conversation listing for voice agent UUID.
Recommendation: Remove Public or require signed dashboard token.
